title: Istanbul Trade Fair Venues: Tüyap, Expo Center, ICC or Haliç — How to Get There and Where to Base Yourself
excerpt: Istanbul's four main fair and congress venues sit in very different parts of the city. Here is how each one connects to the metro, metrobus and airports, which fairs are scheduled into early 2027, and how to choose a base that does not cost you two hours a day in traffic.

body.text: "The fair is in Istanbul" tells you surprisingly little. The city's main exhibition and congress venues are spread from Büyükçekmece on the far western edge to Harbiye in the centre, and the wrong hotel can mean a long commute across the city twice a day. Before you book a room, find the venue on your badge and plan backwards from it.

This guide covers the four venues most international visitors meet, using each venue's own access page and the city transport operator İETT (checked 15 November 2026). For choosing a business district in general, see our [first-time business traveller's guide to Istanbul](/blog/business-travellers-guide-istanbul).
Tüyap Fair Convention and Congress Center (Büyükçekmece)

Tüyap hosts many of the city's large industry fairs and sits at the western end of the metrobus, the bus rapid transit line that runs along the main east–west highway. [İETT's metrobus page](https://iett.istanbul/icerik/metrobus-hatlari) describes a 52 km system with 44 stations and six lines that run 24 hours a day; the western terminus is called Beylikdüzü Son Durak. Tüyap's own [transport page](https://cms.tuyap.com.tr/hostechbytusid/en/transportation) calls the end of the line "Tüyap", so expect both names. Connections listed by Tüyap include M2 at Zincirlikuyu, M1A at Yenibosna–Şirinevler and the T1 tram at Zeytinburnu or Cevizlibağ.

Be realistic about time: İETT gives one-way journey time on the 34BZ Beylikdüzü–Zincirlikuyu metrobus as 95 minutes ([route page](https://iett.istanbul/RouteDetail?hkod=34BZ)). That is the strongest argument for staying out west, near Beylikdüzü or Büyükçekmece, for a multi-day Tüyap fair, and accepting a longer ride on the one evening you want to be in the centre.
Istanbul Expo Center / İstanbul Fuar Merkezi (Yeşilköy)

The Expo Center, still widely called IFM, is on the M1A airport metro line in Yeşilköy, near the former Atatürk Airport. Its [access page](https://ifm.com.tr/en/transportation/how-to-get-to-ifm) sends visitors on the M1A Yenikapı–Atatürk Airport metro to the stop named World Trade Center–Istanbul Fair Center (Dünya Ticaret Merkezi–İstanbul Fuar Merkezi). From Marmaray you can change to M1A at Yenikapı or get off at Yeşilyurt and take a taxi of about five minutes. From Istanbul Airport, IFM suggests the Havaist HVIST-10 bus to Yenibosna and then M1A.

Because the metro runs straight in from the old city side, Yeşilköy, Bakırköy and hotels near M1A stations all work well. IFM's site lists the WOW Hotels and Congress Center and other nearby hotels in its accommodation section ([IFM news page](https://ifm.com.tr/en/ifm-news)).
Istanbul Congress Center and Lütfi Kırdar (Harbiye)

ICC and the neighbouring Lütfi Kırdar centre form the central congress cluster between Taksim and Nişantaşı. The [ICC location page](https://www.iccistanbul.com/location-direction.php) says Osmanbey and Taksim stations on the M2 metro are each about a seven-minute walk away, and gives taxi times of about 37 minutes to Istanbul Airport and 55 minutes to Sabiha Gökçen. The national tourism portal places Lütfi Kırdar about 1.2 km from Taksim Square ([GoTürkiye](https://goturkiye.com/locations/istanbul-lutfi-kirdar-congress-and-exhibition-center)). Hotels near Taksim, Osmanbey or Şişli on the M2 keep you a short ride or walk away, with restaurants close to the venue.

Haliç sits on the Golden Horn shore at Sütlüce, Beyoğlu. Its [location page](https://halic.com/en/?p=10028) highlights arrival by sea from Sütlüce pier, by event boats or city ferries, and road access via the E5 and TEM, with about 7 minutes to Taksim or Eminönü and roughly 35 minutes to Istanbul Airport and 45 to Sabiha Gökçen. Bus, metrobus, shared taxi and ferry are shown as icons, but metro and tram are not listed, so for daily trips budget for taxis or the ferry and choose a hotel in Beyoğlu, Karaköy or near the Golden Horn.
From the venues' own calendars at the time of writing (check exact dates and halls with the organiser):

items: Tüyap ([calendar](https://www.tuyap.com.tr/en/istanbul)): Plast Eurasia from 2 December 2026; International Istanbul Book Fair from 12 December 2026; International Carpet and Flooring Expo from 6 January 2027 (held at the Expo Center); Istanbul Furniture Fair from 19 January 2027 (Tüyap and the Expo Center); KaravanIst from 3 February 2027; Automechanika Istanbul from 24 March 2027.
Istanbul Expo Center ([calendar](https://ifm.com.tr/en/fair-calendar)): NADMEX 2–4 December 2026; WorldFood İstanbul 15–18 December 2026.

body.text: Choosing your base: a quick decision rule

items: Tüyap fair of three days or more: stay west (Beylikdüzü or Büyükçekmece) or at least on the metrobus corridor; avoid the Asian side.
Expo Center: stay on M1A (Yeşilköy, Bakırköy, Zeytinburnu or the historic peninsula) for a one-line commute.
ICC or Lütfi Kırdar: stay near an M2 station from Taksim to Şişli and walk from Osmanbey or Taksim.
Haliç: stay in Beyoğlu or Karaköy and plan taxis or a ferry.
Meetings in Levent or Maslak as well? Pick the venue side for fair days and move hotels if the meeting days are separate.

Arriving from Sabiha Gökçen? Add buffer: all four venues are on the European side, so you cross the Bosphorus before you reach any of them. Our [Istanbul public transport guide](/blog/istanbul-public-transport-tourist-guide) explains Istanbulkart and transfers.

seo.intent: Business visitor attending a trade fair or congress in Istanbul wants to know how to reach the venue and where to stay to keep the commute short.
keywords: where to stay for Tüyap fair
seo.uniqueValue: Compares the four main Istanbul fair and congress venues by their own published access routes and İETT journey times, lists dated fairs into early 2027 from the venue calendars, and gives a venue-to-hotel-area decision rule.

quality.reviewNotes: Independent fact-check 2026-11-15 (separate agent opened all ten sources: İETT metrobus and 34BZ pages, Tüyap transport and calendar, IFM access/news/calendar, ICC location, GoTürkiye Lütfi Kırdar, Haliç). Verified 52 km/44 stations, six 24-hour lines, Beylikdüzü Son Durak vs 'Tüyap' naming, 95-minute 34BZ time, IFM M1A stop name and HVIST-10 route, ICC 7-minute walk and taxi times, Haliç sea/road access and times, all fair dates. Fixes applied: unsupported 'on-site hotel' replaced by IFM accommodation listing, IFM location tied to M1A, carpet expo moved to Tüyap listing, M2 hotel range narrowed to Taksim-Şişli. Reviewer pre-fix score 82. Hotel-area advice is labelled synthesis; metro.istanbul pages could not be opened. Risk low. Localization: DE, zh-CN, KO, ES written by separate agents and reviewed block by block by another independent agent (2026-11-15); two fixes applied (zh-CN three-year rule wording, KO fee-estimate scope); no omissions or number changes found.
